description: Returns newagg's velocity-ranked AI news — each item carries url + velocity + summary (plus dek, beat, date, publishedAt, image, focal). This is the RAW aggregator feed (the same firehose that drives the floor10 news kiosk), a DIFFERENT surface from ic_signal_* (which serves THE SIGNAL, the weekly editorial dispatch). Items come back ranked highest-velocity-first (ties keep the feed's own order). No auth required. Args: { limit?: number (1-25, default 20), min_velocity?: number (>=1, default 1 — keep only items corroborated by >= this many sources), q?: string (2-80 chars, case-insensitive substring over title + summary) }.

limit.description: How many items to return (1-25, default 20).

min_velocity.description: Keep only items corroborated by at least this many sources (default 1).

q.description: Case-insensitive text to find in title and summary (2-80 chars).

name: ic_news_get
title: Get high-velocity AI news (public)
